pairs.question: Diligis me plus his?
pairs.answer: Domine, tu scis quia amo te.
pairs.derivation: Direct-speech exchange embedded in section VII. Dropped the framing narration 'ipse Dominus Petrum apostolum interrogans cum dixisset:' before the question and 'ille respondit:' before the answer. Question kept verbatim with its source '?'. Answer ends at the first full stop; source had a trailing ';' (the sentence continues 'et iterum Dominus quaesiuit...'), normalized to '.'. The later repetitions ('Amas me?', 'utrum diligeret') are woven into Augustine's meta-commentary on diligere vs amare and are reported partly in indirect discourse, so only this first clean exchange is extracted.
